Jet2 Plans Move to London's Main Market as Summer Travel Bookings Rise
By Michael Hennessey
Jet2 said it intends to move to the Main Market of the London Stock Exchange from the junior AIM market, as the airline reported sustained demand during the summer holiday season.
The company said Thursday that the planned move reflects the next step in its development and its confidence in its long-term growth prospects.
Jet2 plans to complete the move to the Main Market before the end of its current financial year in March 2027.

Summer seat capacity is 7.6% higher than summer 2025 at 19.9 million seats, Jet2 said, with booked-to-date passengers up 8.8%. The company said it has seen growth in both package holiday and flight-only products.

Customers have continued to book closer to departure during the peak period, Jet2 noted. The average load factor--a measure of how much of an airline's passenger-carrying capacity is used--to the end of August was 1.5 percentage points ahead of the previous year, the airline said.

Looking ahead, Jet2 said winter capacity is 8.0% higher than the previous year at 5.9 million seats, with the main increase at London Gatwick airport, where the company is performing ahead of its initial expectations.
Jet2 said 93% of its fiscal 2027 jet fuel requirement is now hedged, with over 90% of foreign exchange also hedged.
